selection.rule: highest pooled LOAO endpoint-param macro-F1 (all training apps), fixed before SirAppSec is collected or scored
selection.feature_set_frozen_at: v3 F1-F6 (docs/ml-dast-v3-plan.md, section A), fixed before any v3 training; no feature changes after the v3 collection

freeze.source_hash_covers: sha256 of the sorted lines '<sha256(file)>  <path>' over `git ls-files` at the commit
freeze.ground_truth_hash_covers: json.dumps({app, endpoints, skip, passive, stored, csrf} for sirappsec, sort_keys=True)

scan_config.seed_data: populate.sh lines 1-24 (POST /v1/user/ amit, shir) and one POST /v1/admin/new-beer/ (name 'Beer!!!', price 12), before the scan

freeze.rule: SirAppSec is labelled from source only and never collected for training or tuning; it is collected and scored exactly once by scripts/eval_final_v3.py after the v3 model is fixed by SHA-256. v2 is scored on the same collection.

scan_config.seed_data: populate.sh lines 1-24 (POST /v1/user/ amit, shir) and one POST /v1/admin/new-beer/ (name 'Beer!!!', price 12), before the scan

metric: ML: endpoint-param macro-F1 over the classes present, per-class P/R/F1, cluster bootstrap 1000 (paired v3 vs v2); rules/passive/stored/CSRF: counts
default_model_rule: v3 becomes the packaged default only if (a) its SirAppSec endpoint-param macro-F1 is higher than v2's on the same records AND (b) in leave-one-app-out on the same endpoint-params v3 is not significantly worse than v2 (the 95% CI of v2 - v3 does not lie entirely above 0, reports/before_after_v3.json). Otherwise v2 stays the default and v3 is packaged separately.
